record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The eight units in appliesTo are the four Ogerpon forms (Teal, Wellspring, Hearthflame, Cornerstone) and their four masked variants. All are 3 stars with range 1 and maxPP 100; each variant declares the same passive OGERPON_<FORM> as its unmasked form. The strategy dispatches on the caster's passive value, so the mask variants behave like their form. The mask-drop effect (shield depleted while holding the mask) is only noted, not analysed.
record.summary: Always deals SPECIAL damage to the cast target (raw 50/75/100/200 by caster stars; all eight units are 3 stars = 100). Then one extra effect by the caster's passive: Teal adds +6 attack per enemy adjacent to it; Wellspring gives each adjacent ally +25 PP and a 50 heal; Hearthflame deals 30 SPECIAL damage and a 5000 ms burn to each adjacent enemy; Cornerstone flinches adjacent enemies for 5000 ms and gives itself protect for round(1000 x (2 + AP/100)) ms (halved crit scaling).

targeting.who: base hit: the cast target chosen before the cast. Extra effects: the up-to-eight cells adjacent to the CASTER (not to the target), filtered by team
targeting.note: The strategy never moves the caster or changes the target. The adjacent-cell effects do not exclude the cast target, so an adjacent target is hit twice for Hearthflame (base + 30) and also flinched/burned. Teal's count includes the caster's centre cell but filters it out by team.

geometry.shape: base: single target. Extras: the 3x3 neighbourhood around the caster, on-board cells only

effects.scaling: AP: damage x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost true by default); the cast's crit flag multiplies by critPower only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault is false, so needs ABILITY_CRIT)
effects.resolution: then SPE_DEF division and untraced modifiers; blocked entirely by protect / skydiving / magicBounce

effects.target: each enemy in the 8 cells adjacent to the caster
effects.scaling: same handleSpecialDamage path (AP boost, crit flag passed)
round(6 x enemies x (1 + AP/100)) x critPower if crit, then Big Eater Belt / Twist Band hooks, atk floored at 1; not permanent (permanent flag unset)
effects.resolution: enemy count read AFTER the base damage call, so an enemy that died from it no longer counts if removed from its cell before the count (removal timing not read)

effects.target: each ally in the 8 cells adjacent to the caster (the caster excluded)
effects.scaling: round(25 x (1 + AP/100) x critPower if crit), halved for fatigued receivers
handleHeal(50, caster, apBoost 1, crit): x(1 + AP/100), x critPower on crit, then wound blocks, burn/enraged x0.5, ZENITH x1.2, BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED x1.3, rounded, capped at missing HP

statusEffects.target: each enemy adjacent to the caster
statusEffects.guards: as written the call is triggerBurn(5000, caster, enemy): the `pkm` parameter (used for IMMUNITY_BURN, WATER_BUBBLE, GUTS, WELL_BAKED, Magmarizer, Rawst berry and duration reductions) receives the CASTER, and the `origin` parameter (burnOrigin) receives the burned enemy itself; runeProtect is read on the enemy's own status. Compare HEADBUTT, which passes (target, caster). Whether this is intended was not determined.
statusEffects.combatEffect: burn damage ticking was not analysed

statusEffects.target: each enemy adjacent to the caster
statusEffects.guards: same argument order as burn: pkm = the caster, origin = the flinched enemy; duration reductions are therefore read from the caster; runeProtect is read on the enemy's own status
statusEffects.combatEffect: while flinched a shielded unit takes half of reduced damage on its shield and half on HP (read in HEADBUTT work; not re-read here)

statusEffects.scaling: round(1000 x (2 + AP/100) x (crit ? 1 + (critPower - 1) x 0.5 : 1)) ms
statusEffects.guards: does not stack: not applied if the caster is already protected or enraged

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; all eight units are 3 stars (100 raw). The other columns are not reachable by their bare factory star counts. The extras (6, 25, 50, 30, 5000, 1000) do not depend on stars.

record.positionalConditions: The extras depend on which cells next to the caster hold enemies (Teal, Hearthflame, Cornerstone) or allies (Wellspring) at the cast moment; edge and corner positions have fewer neighbour cells.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: The behaviour is selected by pokemon.passive at each cast, so the four forms are modes by identity. The masked variants carry the same passive. Losing the mask changes name/index (see mask-drop) but not the passive value. No stored state in the strategy; Teal's attack gain stacks over repeated casts for the rest of the fight (not permanent).
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: damage 100 for these 3-star units; Teal +6 atk per adjacent enemy; Wellspring 25 PP and 50 heal; Hearthflame 30 damage and 5000 ms burn; Cornerstone 5000 ms flinch and protect 1000 x (2 + AP/100) ms. Resolved values depend on AP, crit, SPE_DEF, status modifiers and receivers' state.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleSpecialDamage's later modifiers (SPE_DEF division, shields, items, resurrection, field multipliers)
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting, silence) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution - only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate was located
Burn damage over time and what flinch does beyond the shield rule
Whether dead units are still in their cells when the adjacent-cell scans run
unresolved: The OGERPON_* passives' only PassiveEffects entry found is the mask-drop effect (OnShieldDepletedEffect); other behaviour of these passives was not investigated
Whether the (caster, target) argument order in triggerBurn / triggerFlinch calls is intentional; read literally, immunity and duration reductions come from the caster, not the affected enemy
Whether mask-held items add shield or other stats to the masked variants was not examined
Teal's adjacent-enemy count timing relative to deaths caused by the base hit was not traced
Whether the eight units ever reach a different star count than the bare factory value
No gameplay evidence; candidate is source reading plus mechanical checks only
